name: Disneyland Carnation Café Custom Ham & Aged Cheddar Omelet (Skip Walt's Chili Topping!)
brandOrRestaurant: Carnation Café (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Carnation Café cooks three-egg omelets to order; ordering yours with just aged cheddar and diced ham (holding Walt's spicy bean-and-beef chili) turns a trigger dish into a 8.7/10 protein breakfast.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server for a plain Cheddar & Ham Omelet (or Egg-White Omelet) with NO chili topping, paired with breakfast potatoes and sourdough toast.
watchOuts: Never order Walt's Chili-Cheese Omelet with the chili on top during flares (beans + chili powder + tomatoes)
